description: Source code implementation of ReduceLROnPlateauScheduler class for learning rate scheduling in PyTorch's C++ API.

classes.name: ReduceLROnPlateauScheduler
classes.description: Implements a scheduler that reduces the learning rate when a metric has stopped improving.

methods.name: ReduceLROnPlateauScheduler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the scheduler with optimizer, mode, factor, patience, threshold, threshold mode, cooldown, min_lr, epsilon, and verbosity.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Updates the scheduler state based on the current metrics, potentially reducing the learning rate.

methods.name: reduce_lr
methods.description: Reduces the learning rate for each parameter group if conditions are met.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets scheduler state variables to initial values.

methods.name: in_cooldown
methods.description: Checks if the scheduler is currently in cooldown period.

methods.name: is_better
methods.description: Determines if the current metric is better than the best recorded based on mode and threshold mode.

methods.name: init_is_better
methods.description: Initializes the comparison mode for determining if a metric is better.
